title: SDD Manifest
description: Machine-readable contract for a spec-driven repository: coverage status, delta specs, WHAT+WHY, provenance, and validation runtime separation. The validator's methodology axis (spec-validator Axis-A) checks specs against this file. Lives at .sdd/manifest.json in the target repo. Repo-pinned 0.2.2 extension at .sdd/config/sdd-manifest.schema.json (test_index_path, template_library_*, has_submodules, validation status fields) until upstream plugin schema catches up.

purpose.description: One sentence: what this repo is.

category.description: History-depth axis (NOT part of the topology/mode classifier). greenfield | cat1-legacy (rich commit/PR history) | cat2-legacy (>10yr, history/tribal-knowledge lost). Drives only whether doc-backfill may use commit history for WHY. See config/classification.md.

primary_languages.description: Drives patterns/ and rules/ CONTENT (not section shape).

topology.description: The doc tree mirrors this. Set by repo-bootstrap.

commands.description: Real, runnable commands read from the repo's actual build config (never guessed). Keys are task names. String values are retained for backward compatibility; object values carry provenance for validator checks.

source_file.description: Build/config file where this command was discovered.

coverage_status_definitions.description: SDD coverage status = how complete the SPEC is for a module (distinct from AI-autonomy zones — do not conflate). Defaults shown; a repo may tighten thresholds, never loosen below these.

specced.default: >=80% public surface specced, drift <5% — spec is authoritative

partial.default: 40-80% specced — spec is a hint, cross-check code

untracked.default: <40% specced — code is the source of truth

modules.description: Every module that gets (or will get) dedicated SDD docs.

coverage_evidence.description: WHY this status — e.g. 'public API 82% documented, last 5 PRs zero MODIFIED requirements'. Not a bare percentage and not a path to a local generated report.

canonical_spec.description: Path to the module's canonical spec, combining orientation and detailed behavior, or omitted if none yet (Untracked).

architecture_doc.description: Optional path to a separate module architecture document for legacy or unusually large modules. New SDD bootstrap runs should normally use canonical_spec only.

contracts.description: The module's current Provides/Requires baseline. Later code and spec changes are measured against this.

characterization_baseline.description: Path to the characterization-test suite pinning current behavior. Required before modifying a Partial/Untracked module.

section_profile.description: Per-module section-selection profile resolving module-spec Include-if conditions (M-1 through M-16). true = KEEP, false = DROP, null = PENDING (needs human input). Written by brownfield-questionnaire; consumed by doc-emitting skills and spec-validator A11. Per-field audit trail lives in the decision log.

has_ui.description: M-1: Does this module have a UI? Resolves module-spec § UI flow per use case.

crosses_service_boundaries.description: M-2: Does this module call other services over the network? Resolves module-spec § cross-service flow.

enforces_domain_rules.description: M-3: Does it enforce domain rules or entity invariants? Resolves module-spec § Business Rules & Invariants.

is_concurrent_async.description: M-4: Is it concurrent, async, reactive, or event-driven? Resolves module-spec § Concurrency & Reactive Flow.

owns_persistence.description: M-5: Does it own persistence (its own tables/store)? Resolves module-spec § Data / Schema + § Schema / Migration Discipline.

returns_caller_errors.description: M-6: Does it return/raise errors a caller must handle? Resolves module-spec § Error Handling & Failure Modes.

has_design_tradeoff.description: M-7: Is there a non-obvious design trade-off a consumer must know? Resolves module-spec § Key Design Trade-off. Typically requires human input.

stateful_transitions.description: M-8: Does the module have non-trivial state transitions? Resolves module-spec § State Machine.

exposes_wire_protocol.description: M-9: Does it expose a wire protocol or binary format? Resolves module-spec § Protocol / Wire Format.

ui_multi_screen.description: M-10: Is it a UI with a multi-screen flow? Resolves module-spec § UI Flow.

large_data_model.description: M-11: Does it own a large or complex data model? Resolves module-spec § Data Model.

has_tiers.description: M-12: Does the repo tier its modules? Resolves module-spec § Tier.

module_specific_conventions.description: M-13: Does it have conventions beyond repo-wide rules? Resolves module-spec § Module Do's / Don'ts.

published_package.description: M-14: Is it published/consumed as a package? Resolves module-spec § Export Stability.

embedded_in_host.description: M-15: Is it embedded into a host application? Resolves module-spec § Host Integration & Theming.

holds_client_state.description: M-16 [INFERRED — template has this condition but plan omits it from M-1..M-15]: Does this module hold client-side state? Resolves module-spec § State Model.

resolved_by.description: Who resolved this module's profile (agent + runtime, or human).

resolved_at.description: When this module's profile was last resolved.

has_submodules.description: Does this module contain child modules that own their own specs? Resolves module-spec § Sub-modules.

source_policy.description: Module-specific routing for older specs/docs discovered before SDD onboarding. Agents use canonical_spec; this object explains how older material was handled.

conflict_status.description: pending means reconciliation found a conflict that must be resolved before this module's canonical spec can be promoted.

decision_record.description: Decision log or run record that explains this module's policy choice and any conflict resolution.

spec_source_policy.description: Explicit policy chosen when onboarding detected existing specs/docs. If existing specs are present and this object is absent, spec-source-policy must stop and ask for a decision.

mode.description: No default is allowed. The user must choose the policy before spec-writing continues.

spec_sources.description: Existing specs/docs or native contract/API sources discovered before SDD onboarding. Entries route old material as context/source only unless explicitly made canonical through the normal canonical_spec fields. Native schema/API sources may remain authoritative for exact contracts while SDD markdown links to them.

scope.description: Classification of an existing source document. feature is retained only so migration can route legacy change-specific source material.

module.description: Module path when scope is module.

canonical.description: False for preserved older specs. Agents use modules[].canonical_spec and manifest-routed standing docs.

canonical_target.description: Canonical SDD path selected by onboarding or migration routing for this source, when applicable.

notes.description: Use this to record how an older spec or native contract/API source is linked from the generated SDD docs.

delta_grammar.description: Every spec change is a delta against canonical spec sections.

require_what_and_why.description: Every requirement (incl. ADDED, not only MODIFIED) must state WHAT and WHY. Validator Axis-A fails the spec otherwise.

require_provenance.description: Every spec/delta records author, approver, date.

protected_specs.description: Canonical specs that must never be overwritten in place. A change to one must go through spec-reconcile and land as a MODIFIED delta with migration. This is the no-override guard.

required_sections_by_change_class.description: Conditional section library: which spec sections are required for which class of change. Core is always required; the rest are gated so a trivial change isn't taxed with a 12-section spec.

generator_runtime.description: Opaque runtime identifier resolved from the active generation context when execution begins. Runtime names are not enumerated or inferred from model families, credential variables, or skill installation paths.

generator_model.description: Opaque model identifier supplied by the active generation context, when available.

generator_runtime_source.description: How generator_runtime was obtained. Environment resolution uses explicit SDD_RUNTIME_ID input only; provider credentials and model-family heuristics are not runtime identity.

validator_runtime.description: Opaque runtime identifier independently resolved from the active validation context. Written during validator preflight and absent until validation runs.

validator_model.description: Opaque model identifier supplied by the active validation context, when available.

minimum_independence.description: Repository-approved minimum separation. different-runtime is the default. Lower levels must be explicitly selected by a human before validation; the validator never silently weakens this policy.

must_differ.description: Deprecated compatibility field from earlier manifests. When present it means generation and validation execution identities must differ; minimum_independence defines the enforceable level.

runtime_fallback_tier.description: Separation established by validator preflight. Different-model requires both model ids and different-session requires both run ids; self-asserted freshness is not evidence. The value must satisfy minimum_independence.

generator_run_id.description: Opaque generation run or session id supplied by the active execution context, when available; do not use a local report path.

validator_run_id.description: Opaque validation run or session id independently supplied by the active execution context, when available; required to establish different-session separation.

source_commit.description: Target repo commit SHA used for generation/validation.

status.description: Latest independent validator verdict. not-run until Session B records a HEAD result.

validated_at.description: Date or timestamp of the recorded validator run.

evidence_summary.description: Short measured evidence summary. Must not cite local .generated/ report paths.

layout.description: Repository-specific SDD layout. Default generated docs live under ai-docs; generators must honor these paths and rewrite template navigation links accordingly instead of assuming docs/templates or docs/modules.

agent_entry_path.description: Root agent entry file kept at repo root for tool auto-discovery.

standing_docs_root.description: Default root folder for standing SDD docs such as ARCHITECTURE, RULES, CONTRACTS, and SPEC_INDEX.

module_docs_root.description: Only used when module_docs_strategy is central or a repo explicitly chooses a shared docs folder.

extensions.description: Template extension roots loaded after canonical templates, recursively and in lexical order. Mirrored relative paths override canonical files; extension-only templates use .ext.template.md and a Template-ID ending in -ext.

legacy_compat.description: Optional read-only migration path for older repos. The canonical template root remains template_roots.canonical, not ai-docs.

runtime_skill_entrypoints.description: Optional map from an opaque runtime id to the skill entrypoint used by that installation. Runtime ids and paths are discovered or supplied at installation/execution time; the plugin does not enumerate them.

test_index_path.description: Path to the repo-wide TEST_INDEX.md standing doc.

tooling.description: Tool/source provenance for generated SDD assets. Records which SDD-Bootstrap checkout produced the repo state.

source_repo.description: Git remote URL or local source identifier for the SDD-Bootstrap checkout used to generate assets.

template_library_version.description: Pinned SDLC template-library semver used to generate standing docs and module specs.

coverage_ratchet.description: Once a module reaches a coverage status, it cannot be downgraded except via an expiring, approver-signed waiver. Direction of travel is up.

substrate.description: The repo-standards layer this repo CONSUMES (does not author). Bootstrap detects and leaves these alone.

compliance_tier.description: The repo-standards tier this repo runs at, if any. Recorded for cross-reference only; coverage status is the SDD axis and is tracked separately.

section_profiles.description: Questionnaire-resolved section-selection profiles for repo-level Include-if conditions. Per-module profiles live inside each module item. true = KEEP section, false = DROP section, null = PENDING (emit as scaffold with [NEEDS HUMAN INPUT]). Written by brownfield-questionnaire; consumed by doc-emitting skills and spec-validator A11.

repo.description: Repo-level profile resolving ARCHITECTURE.template.md Include-if conditions (R-1 through R-14).

owns_datastore.description: R-1: Does this repo own a datastore (persists its own data)? Resolves ARCHITECTURE § Data & Schema.

holds_client_state.description: R-2: Does this repo hold client-side state (UI store, in-memory model)? Resolves ARCHITECTURE § State Model.

components_interact.description: R-3: Do components/services call each other or exchange events? Resolves ARCHITECTURE § Dependency / Interaction Topology.

domain_data_across_components.description: R-4: Does the repo own domain data spread across components? Resolves ARCHITECTURE § Object / Data Ownership.

caches_data.description: R-5: Does this repo cache data? Resolves ARCHITECTURE § Caching Catalog.

observability_convention.description: R-6: Is there a logging/metrics/audit convention worth standardizing? Resolves ARCHITECTURE § Observability Patterns.

deploys_to_infra.description: R-7: Does this repo deploy to or depend on infrastructure? Resolves ARCHITECTURE § Infrastructure Matrix.

shared_base_libs.description: R-8: Does the repo inherit a shared/base library stack? Resolves ARCHITECTURE § Shared / Base Libraries.

is_monorepo.description: R-9: Is this repo a monorepo (multiple packages in one tree)? Resolves ARCHITECTURE § Package Map & Inter-Package Dependencies.

multi_platform.description: R-10: Does the repo target multiple platforms? Resolves ARCHITECTURE § Platform Matrix.

published_package.description: R-11: Is this repo published/consumed as a package? Resolves ARCHITECTURE § Release & Versioning.

embedded_in_host.description: R-12: Is this repo embedded into a host application? Resolves ARCHITECTURE § Host Integration & Theming.

cross_repo_deps_material.description: R-13: Are cross-repo dependencies material? Resolves ARCHITECTURE § Cross-Repo Dependency Graph.

security_arch_warranted.description: R-14: Does the security architecture warrant its own view? Resolves ARCHITECTURE § Security Architecture.

resolved_by.description: Who resolved the repo-level profile (agent + runtime, or human).

resolved_at.description: When the repo-level profile was last resolved.
